description: Defines the ITaskService interface which declares asynchronous methods for task management operations in a task management API.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task item by its GUID asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new task item based on provided DTO.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task item identified by GUID with provided DTO.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task item identified by GUID.
